description: This file contains the implementation of a database driver for SAPDB within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library. It defines the class ADODB_SAPDB which extends ADODB_odbc, providing methods for retrieving server info, primary keys, indexes, columns, and handling database-specific operations. It also defines a recordset class ADORecordSet_sapdb for SAPDB-specific record handling.

classes.name: ADODB_SAPDB
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a SAPDB database driver extending the ODBC driver class, providing database-specific methods for metadata retrieval and connection handling.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_sapdb
classes.description: A class extending ADORecordSet_odbc to handle SAPDB-specific record set operations.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server information, including version, with fallback parsing from description.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a given table.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a table, optionally including primary index info.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves detailed metadata about columns of a table.

methods.name: MetaColumnNames
methods.description: Retrieves the column names of a table.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID for a table using SAPDB-specific sequence handling.
